title: DBinventory
text: One call whole run: inventory_run() accepts anything db_connect() : DBI connection, ODBC connection string DSN name, .sqlite .duckdb file, .parquet file directory . Re-running store resumes: tables already profiled skipped. Use resume = FALSE start .
code: library(DBinventory)  out <- inventory_run(   "Driver={ODBC Driver 18 for SQL Server};Server=warehouse;Database=DW;Trusted_Connection=yes;TrustServerCertificate=yes;",   store      = "dw_inventory.sqlite",   # results and checkpoints   export_dir = "dw_inventory_csv",      # one CSV per store table   report     = "dw_inventory.html"      # the rendered report )  out$inventory$tables   # one row per table or view out$profile            # one row per column # a directory of Parquet files, one schema per subdirectory out <- inventory_run("data/v2/sample", store = "sample_inventory.sqlite")  # the bundled synthetic hospital database, for a first look out <- inventory_run(fakehosp_path(), store = "fakehosp_inventory.sqlite")

title: DBinventory
code: con <- db_connect("Driver={ODBC Driver 18 for SQL Server};Server=...;Database=...;Trusted_Connection=yes;")  tables  <- db_tables(con, schema = "dbo", exclude = "\\.tmp_|_backup$") inv     <- db_inventory(con, schema = "dbo")           # tables + columns + counts + freshness + sizes prof    <- db_profile(con, inv, sample_rows = 1e6,     # sample tables above a million rows                       store = "dw_inventory.sqlite")   # checkpoint per table dups    <- duplicate_candidates(prof)                  # same data in more than one table? render_report("dw_inventory.sqlite", "dw_inventory.html")  DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

title: DBinventory
text: choices made brief left room; easy change. Values suppressed default. profile hospital warehouse committed repository, min_value, max_value top_values withheld columns inferred identifiers free text columns whose names suggest personal data (nhs, mrn, postcode, dob, name, address, …). Hashes fingerprints computed suppression, copies still match. Pass keep_values = TRUE output held securely. Large tables sampled. Exact COUNT(*) MAX(datetime) always run full table; value statistics tables sample_rows (default million) computed sample materialised session temporary table (TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM SQL Server, USING SAMPLE reservoir DuckDB, ORDER random() SQLite, TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (pct) PostgreSQL; views SQL Server fall back first rows). sampled sample_method record happened. sample_rows = Inf disables . One query per table aggregates, one per eligible column top values. Aggregates batched column_batch columns time. Top values skipped columns top_values_max_distinct distinct values, frequency table says little. SELECT needed. Metadata comes INFORMATION_SCHEMA (sqlite_master SQLite). Table sizes come sys.dm_db_partition_stats SQL Server pg_total_relation_size PostgreSQL login can see , NA otherwise. Temporary tables need extra rights. Statistics type support skipped, failed. MIN() SQL Server bit, COUNT(DISTINCT) text, ntext, xml geography; timestamp SQL Server classified binary (row version). table fails reason logged profile_log run continues. store SQLite. single file, needs RSQLite, checkpoint. store_export() writes CSV (always) Parquet (arrow duckdb). report Quarto document inst/report/inventory_report.qmd, rendered Quarto CLI present otherwise rmarkdown::render(), handles knitr chunks.
